assumptions.baseline: Unmodified simulate() standard policies for continuous typing 300 physical keys/min and clicking 8/s. Free online materials, OCR/office disabled, real purchases and prestige, no cash/knowledge/equipment/experience grants.
assumptions.observation: onBeforeInput runs immediately before each actual manual input, after mode/subject/review decisions. It only deep-clones the first eligible state at each stage. The source career is never changed by the observer.
assumptions.timing: Manual input and core time advance in one-second steps. Purchasing, project selection, publication, and prestige decisions run every 15 seconds. Recorded activeSeconds includes the current input second.
assumptions.snapshots: First knowledge-ready implementation state of the first project, first commercial project, funding indie after five prestiges, first 3D, and first AAA. This benchmark follows fixed tutorial projects, not custom plans.
assumptions.quizExperiment: Each experiment uses a deep clone. It changes only UI mode/language/subject/cursor/review choices and calls completeQuiz. No time passes while solving: no extra purchases, sales, automatic implementation, or automatic study are credited.
assumptions.learningCounterfactual: newLearning=false marks general quiz rewarded IDs as already claimed without changing knowledge or equipment. This isolates implementation/repair capacity conservatively; it is not a separately simulated earlier quiz route.
assumptions.finiteBank: General bank has 512 distinct problems; C++ has 64. Only subjects required by the current project are eligible (48 C++/384 all-language problems for indie). Each implementation is used at most once on this project. The first project uses its separate staged part quizzes.
assumptions.maintenance: Use remaining, unclaimed problems for actual review when defect/efficiency thresholds require it, or after implementation completes. A problem cannot be spent on both implementation and review on the same project.
assumptions.upperBound: For steady policy, fixed equipment, sufficient knowledge: characters <= 32 * sum(physical keys) * (handPower * IDE + devCapacity / 160) * abstraction, with abstraction <= 3 and debt efficiency <= 1. This is a bound, not extra granted progress.
assumptions.interpretation: Snapshot question counts are not a full quiz-driven career time. Reading, thinking, editing, compilation, failures, and retries are unmeasured. Quiz reward work is abstract implementation effort, not literal submitted source length.

firstProjectFreshStart.method: Actual new save, free syntax material opened, no prior study or other input; switch directly to development quizzes.
